From this moment forward, whenever you wish to reduce
physical discomfort in any part of your body,
you can do so quickly and easily.

Begin by bringing your awareness to the area
where the discomfort begins.

Close your eyes and focus your attention on that area.

Take a deep breath in and gently hold it.

While holding your breath, silently say to yourself,
"Plus Five Five Five One Five."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth,
as though gently blowing out a candle.

As you exhale, the discomfort signals will begin
to diminish, becoming weaker and weaker.

Feel the discomfort fading away,
less and less, until it no longer demands
your attention.

Your body will become more comfortable,
calm, and relaxed.

Your mind will become clear and peaceful,
free to focus on whatever you choose.

You will remain aware of your body's needs
while experiencing greater comfort and ease.

Whenever you wish to reduce discomfort,
simply close your eyes, inhale deeply,
and gently hold your breath.

Focus on the area of discomfort and silently
say to yourself, "Plus Five Five Five One Five."

Then exhale slowly through your mouth.

The discomfort will quickly become less and less,
fading into the background until it is
no longer important to you.

Each time you use Plus Five Five Five One Five,
this process becomes easier, smoother,
faster, and more effective.

You are in control of your response to discomfort.

You can return to a state of calm,
comfort, and relaxation whenever you desire.
